title: The wrong way: forgetting to trim
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output text/plain
---
payload splitBy "|" map (upper($[0]) ++ lower($[1 to -1])) joinBy "\n"

solution:
%dw 2.0
output text/plain
---
payload splitBy "|" map (upper($[0]) ++ lower($[1 to -1])) joinBy "\n"

explanation.approach: Without trim(), each name still has its spaces. When you apply the formula to " alice ", the first char is a space and the rest is "alice ", so you get space + lowercase(alice ), which gives " alice ". The spaces are untouched.
